svg.text: verse 19 — Lamech took two wives: Adah, and Zillah.
Cain's line as the chapter gives it — seven generations; Seth's line is taken up in Genesis 5
it will not yield to you
Cain the tiller, Abel the shepherd
Cain rose up against his brother
the blood cries out from the ground
vengeance sevenfold on whoever slays him
Cain lived in the land of Nod
tents, harp and pipe, brass and iron
and Enosh — men call on Yahweh’s name
